The competition is held under the aegis «Pivdennyi» («Southern») Research and Training Consortium of research institutions, agricultural institutions of higher education and industrial enterprises of Ukraine, the Scientific Park MNAU «Agroperspective», the Educational Innovation Cluster «Agrotechnics», and the National Innovation Cluster «Rodiuchist’ Hruntiv» («Soil Fertility»), a co-founder of which is the Mykolayiv National Agrarian University
The Competition is open to students of any kind of higher education institution, who at the time of completion of the second stage of the Competition are students studying at a bachelor’s or master’s degree.
Up to five research papers in each specialty from one higher education institution can participate in the Competition.
One paper cannot have more than two authors and two supervisors.
During the Competition, the processing of personal data is carried out following the requirements of the Law of Ukraine «On Personal Data Protection» dated 01.06.2010 №2297-VI (as amended).
The results of the first stage of the second round the International Competition of Student Research Papers “Agricultural Sciences and Food”
On May 20, 2021, the first stage of the second round of the International competition of student research papers in certain specialties in the field of knowledge 20 “Agricultural Sciences and Food” was officially completed. The Competition is held on the basis of the Mykolayiv National Agrarian University with information support of the State scientific institution “Institute of Education Content Modernization” of the Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine (the letter from 08/26/2020 № 22.1 / 10-1686).
Registration of participants and submission of works for the first stage of the second round of the Competition lasted until April 15, 2021. At the first stage of the Competition 248 works were submitted from Ukrainian and foreign higher education institutions, including 24 universities of such countries as India, Poland, Slovakia, Azerbaijan, Sweden, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Belarus, Moldova, China, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Latvia.
At the first stage of the second round of the Competition, the scientific works were reviewed by the jury members and discussed at the meetings held on May 17-18, 2021. Finalists were determined for each specialty (25% of the number of peer-reviewed works according to the rating) and they are invited to participate in the second stage of the second round of the Competition.
